confidence.verified: buildingCode seen in live Autumn 2026 schedule data AND an independent OSM building of the same name within 25 m
confidence.high: buildingCode seen in live schedule data, coordinate from OSU GIS only
confidence.unconfirmed: present in OSU GIS for a walkable campus but never seen in the 36-subject schedule sample; included so a full harvest cannot miss

_meta.warning: Campus is an ADMINISTRATIVE field, not a geographic one. 82 records here with Campus = Columbus or Medical Center sit more than 10 km from the Oval (remote clinics, transmitters). Filter on km_from_oval, not on campus. Also: the class API returns three Wooster buildings (404, 414, 549) under campus=col, 126 km away.
_meta.km_from_oval: great-circle km from 40.0006,-83.0140. 77 of the 80 observed buildings are within 2.62 km. The one legitimate far outlier is 1019 Knowlton Executive Terminal at 9.79 km, which is Don Scott Field, where AVIATN sections really meet.
